summary: Risk-on tape is holding and firming (S&P about +2.1%, Nasdaq +2.35%, Dow +1.8% near 11 AM ET) on falling oil, with Nvidia still down about 5.5% on the Huang probe. Since the last update the list is unchanged: AMD pushed toward $495 so its $500 trigger is closer and confidence was raised, DraftKings put confidence was trimmed again; live quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 10% on the Oppenheimer upgrade ($600 target) and Google Cloud deal; a clean break of $500 targets $512.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 5% on JPMorgan's focus list (AWS growth above 40%) with the index rally firming; holding above $270 keeps $275-280 in play.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up about 5% after JPMorgan added it to its focus list ($940 target); a break of the 644.54 intraday high extends it.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5.5% on the board probe of CEO Huang and lagging the chip rally; losing the opening low near $171.50 resumes the slide.

picks.name: Eli Lilly
picks.reason: Up about 2% after Jefferies set a street-high $1,700 target on ex-US GLP-1 demand; a break of $1,400 extends it.

picks.name: DraftKings
picks.reason: Triple downgrade (UBS, Stifel, JPMorgan) after Friday's 21% guidance-cut drop, but the strong risk-on tape is capping follow-through.
